Guideline: Pair useActionState / useFormStatus with Immediate Tactile Feedback
Description: Never let a Server Action submit feel dead while waiting for the server roundtrip.
Do: Use useFormStatus().pending for immediate button compression + morphing spinner, and useOptimistic for instant list/counter updates
Don't: Submit a form with zero immediate visual change on the submit button
Code Good: const { pending } = useFormStatus(); <button disabled={pending} className='active:scale-[0.97] data-[pending=true]:scale-[0.98]' data-pending={pending}>
Code Bad: <button type='submit'>Submit</button> /* Feels dead for 400ms on slow networks */
